Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/http_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 36, "var": "data[0]", "code": "if (GET_MOD_EQ(2,1)) { proxy = get_null_terminated(50, &data, &size); }", "note": "data[0]=1 is odd so GET_MOD_EQ(2,1) is true; the next 50 input bytes are copied into the attacker-controlled proxy string."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/http_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 43, "var": "proxy", "code": "c = flb_http_client(u_conn, method, uri, NULL, 0, \"127.0.0.1\", 8001, proxy, 0);", "note": "The non-NULL proxy pointer is passed into the http_client constructor, which will attempt to parse it."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/flb_http_client.c", "function": "proxy_parse", "line": 476, "var": "proxy", "code": "else { return -1; }", "note": "The proxy string starts with 'A' (0x41), not 'http://' or 'https://', so proxy_parse returns -1 (parse failure)."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/flb_http_client.c", "function": "flb_http_client", "line": 720, "var": "buf", "code": "if (ret != 0) { flb_free(buf); flb_http_client_destroy(c); return NULL; }", "note": "On proxy parse failure, flb_free(buf) frees the header buffer that c->header_buf already points to."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/flb_http_client.c", "function": "flb_http_client_destroy", "line": 1277, "var": "c->header_buf", "code": "flb_free(c->header_buf);", "note": "flb_http_client_destroy frees c->header_buf, which aliases the already-freed buf, causing a heap double-free."}
]
EOF
echo "done"` executed with exit code 0.
